answer: Replica accounts fail a climb they cannot pre-walk. The joiner locks 5.85 POA, takes a 15-byte onyx tablet milled from this epoch seed mixed with a 41-bit cairn ticket posted 14 minutes earlier, and climbs the posted knoll in a 13-minute window. Halfway they seat the tablet in a 28-mm socket; two unaligned rangers hash a 6-second lamp wink and press a wet opal flake with the slope bearing. Clerks rebuild those hashes and scrap any second tablet on that cairn. Bill: 5.85 POA plus the live climb. A dry flake, reused tablet, or missed wink takes 63% and shuts the cairn seven epochs.
